explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/743 (Gyárfás's tree packing conjecture): for trees T_2,…,T_n with T_k on k vertices, can K_n always be written as the edge-disjoint union of the T_k? The Lean statement: for every n and every family of trees T k on Fin k (2 ≤ k ≤ n), IsPacking n [2,n] T, i.e. injective maps f_k : Fin k → Fin n with pairwise edge-disjoint images. Since Σ_{k=2}^n (k−1) = C(n,2) (proved in the file), an edge-disjoint packing into K_n automatically covers every edge, so packing is equivalent to decomposition, as the docstring explains; trees on Fin k represent all trees up to isomorphism. Faithful (positive form of the yes/no question).
